## Mathematics

$$
C = S_0 N(d_1) - K e^{-rT} N(d_2).

## Python execution and figures

The following cell executes during rendering and produces a small plot of $y=x^2$.

```{python}
#| label: fig-square
#| fig-cap: "A simple numerical plot of y = x²."

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

x = np.linspace(-3, 3, 61)
y = x**2

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 3.5))
ax.plot(x, y, color="#24527a", linewidth=2)
ax.set(xlabel="x", ylabel="y", title=r"$y = x^2$")
ax.grid(alpha=0.2)
plt.show()
```
